products.title: Products
products.description: How each product in your catalog performs across AI shopping agents.

embedBanner.title: Structured data is not reaching your product pages
embedBanner.description: The "Agentic structured data" app embed is off, so AI agents don't see machine-readable data on your products. Turn it on once and every product in this store gets structured data.

detail.acrossCompetitors: across {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}}

replay.empty: No simulations yet. Run a scan to see agent decision replays.
replay.noReasoning: No reasoning recorded. Decided by score ({productScore} vs {competitorScore}).

publish.dialogDescription: ecentic generates an AI-optimized title and description for "{title}" and writes it directly to your connected store, replacing the live listing. Current win rate is {winRate}%.
publish.successDescription: An AI-optimized listing was pushed to your store.

applyOptimization.title: Close the gap automatically
applyOptimization.description: ecentic rewrites this listing from the winning competitors' strengths and publishes it straight to your store, with no manual edits from you.

shelf.title: Who else sells this
shelf.description: Sellers we have seen carrying this product, cheapest first, with any price movement since the last check.
shelf.observed: {count, plural, one {Seen once, {when}} other {Seen # times, last {when}}}

found.title: Competing offers found
found.description: {count, plural, one {# seller carries this product} other {# sellers carry this product}}

none.title: No competing offers
none.exclusive: No other seller appears to carry this product.
none.budget: You have used this month's offer lookups.
none.unconfigured: Offer lookup is not enabled on this environment.

battlecard.empty: No competitor data available. Run a scan to generate battlecards.

optimizeTab.title: Optimize Listing
optimizeTab.description: Category-aware content-quality scores for the fields AI agents read, plus how this listing is positioned for its audience.
optimizeTab.structuredDataHelp: The app embed already renders default structured data from the live product content. Publishing writes this AI-optimized version to the {metafield} metafield, and the embed renders it instead of the default.
optimizeTab.noStructuredDataYet: No optimized structured data yet. The app embed renders the default markup built from the live product content. Generate an AI-optimized version to override it.
optimizeTab.structuredDataPublishedDescription: Written to the ecentic.structured_data metafield. The app embed now renders it in place of the default product markup. If the embed is off, turn it on in the theme editor and press Save.

embedNotice.embedOffText: Optimized structured data is published for this product, but the "Agentic structured data" app embed is off, so no ecentic markup reaches the page. Turning it on once applies to every product in the store.
embedNotice.missingTitle: No structured data on the page
embedNotice.missingText: AI agents see no machine-readable product data. Turn on the "Agentic structured data" app embed. That one toggle adds structured data for every product in the store.
embedNotice.storeDefaultText: Only the theme's own markup is live, and it is usually thin: no GTIN, one offer, no variant detail. Turn on the ecentic app embed, which applies to all products, then publish optimized structured data below for this one.
embedNotice.standardText: The app embed renders default structured data from the live product content. Publish the AI-optimized version below to give agents richer, more competitive markup for this product.

add.title: Add Products
add.description: Bring more of your catalog in from the platform this store is connected to. Everything you add here belongs to this store only.

platformSync.description: Re-reads {domain} and adds every product that isn't in this store yet. Products already here are refreshed in place, so their scans and optimizations are kept.

csv.title: Upload a CSV
csv.description: This store was built from a file rather than a connected platform, so there's nothing upstream to pull from. Upload another CSV to add to it.
csv.noProductsDescription: Check that your CSV has a header row with a title or name column.
csv.importSuccess: {count, plural, one {# product imported} other {# products imported}}

insights.noFindingTitle: No finding recorded for this scan.
insights.noFindingHint: Rerun the scan to see insights.
